hooks.statusMessage: Checking for test changes on master...

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])git[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run lint >/tmp/.meccg-lint-check.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /tmp/.meccg-lint-check.log >&2; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Lint failed — fix errors before pushing"}}\n'; exit $rc
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.md$' && npm run lint:md 2>&1 || true; }
